findings.text: CO-1 says RefList renders the Doctors cell and is changed, but the only cite is the RefList symbol id, which proves the name exists, not that it renders the department/specialization tables. Not marked Assumed.

cites.quote: The Settings count is a `doctor_count` of every doctor using the entry
already carries the id, name, status and doctor count each row needs (C3)

findings.text: The design reads `doctorCount` from the row, but its own C14 names the API value `doctor_count`. RefEntry's fields (id, name, status, count) are cited only by the symbol id, so the field name the link uses is unproven.

cites.quote: The Settings count includes doctors of every status (C14), so the list and the count match
empty when the parameter is absent
lists all 3 doctors, the Inactive one included, matching the count

findings.text: REQ-3 match is argued from the UI status filter (C8) and the SQL count (C14) only; nothing cites that GET /api/doctors with no status returns doctors of every status, which AC2 of S-1/S-2 depends on.
